plain_english_policy: This bill establishes a new criminal restriction prohibiting adult sex offenders from living within 2,000 feet of public parks and playgrounds in Alabama. It also maintains existing prohibitions against residing near schools or the homes of victims.
policy_direction_if_enacted: Enactment would expand residential restrictions for registered sex offenders by adding a specific buffer zone around recreational areas (parks/playgrounds) where minors congregate, alongside maintaining zones around educational institutions and victim residences. It defines loitering within 500 feet of these facilities as a crime if the offender has no legitimate purpose or remains beyond necessary time.
sponsorship_supports_position: The sponsors affirmatively advanced this bill to restrict where adult criminal sex offenders can live and work near areas frequented by children.
evidence_quotes: "This bill would prohibit an adult criminal sex offender from establishing a residence or any other living accommodation within 2,000 feet of the property on which a public park or a playground is located and would provide penalties."

"(h) Unless otherwise exempted by law, no adult criminal sex offender shall establish a residence or any other living accommodation within 2,000 feet of property on which any playground or park is located."
